svg.text: The all-white figure: circle head, dot eyes, brows, a line mouth, one body shape, tube limbs, mitten hands, round feet; far limbs a shade darker.
His own marks: the three-stroke tuft and a bare neck (no scarf, no hood).
short thin brows do the acting; eye bags only when he is worn out
SILHOUETTE TEST (black on light, no face)
the tuft and the bare neck read even as a black shape
whole rig: head + tuft, 2 eyes, 2 brows, mouth, body, 4 tubes, 2 mittens, 2 feet
